tools.name: review_answer_evidence
tools.description: Mark one recorded answer run reviewed, not published or improved. Requires its saved stateVersion and idempotencyKey. New runs remain separate. No provider work.

tools.name: restore_answer_evidence
tools.description: Restore a reviewed recorded run to the review queue using stateVersion and idempotencyKey. No provider work, content publication or outcome claim.

tools.name: read_preparation_action
tools.description: Read one owned mapped action, its current stateVersion and cursor-paginated audit history. Saved data only; no provider work.

tools.name: review_preparation_action
tools.description: Mark a suggestion reviewed using expectedVersion and idempotencyKey. Task triage only, not copy approval, generation, publication or outcome verification.

tools.name: dismiss_preparation_action
tools.description: Dismiss suggested/reviewed/prepared work without deleting artifacts. Requires expectedVersion and idempotencyKey. Prevents future automatic preparation; does not undo already running work or applied evidence.

tools.name: restore_preparation_action
tools.description: Restore dismissed/archived work with expectedVersion and idempotencyKey. Preserve existing applied/prepared evidence or return to suggested. No immediate provider work/job submission. Fresh suggestions can resume scheduled preparation; failed drafts remain explicit retries.

tools.name: qualify_domain
tools.description: Judge whether a domain is worth running link building for at all, from live search data. Returns a verdict, the measured signals behind it, and the honest case against. This is the same free diagnostic the dashboard runs, and for a large share of sites the answer is that the niche has nothing to min

tools.name: read_site
tools.description: Read a domain and return what we think it is about: a description, its audience, and the keywords it should be found for. This is the brief every other tool takes as input, so call it first when you do not already have one.

tools.name: discover_competitors
tools.description: Find the domains competing with this one, from both search results and link profile overlap. Returns each candidate with the evidence for it, so a wrong suggestion can be recognised rather than trusted.

tools.name: backlink_gap
tools.description: Find pages that link to the named competitors but not to you, classified by whether a link is realistically winnable and why. Competitors are excluded from their own results: a competitor is never a prospect.

tools.name: find_prospects
tools.description: Search the open web for pages that would plausibly link to this site: resource pages, roundups, listicles and directories in its subject. Returns each with the reason it was kept.

tools.name: verify_links
tools.description: Check a list of domains against your live backlink profile and report which of them now link to you, when the link first appeared, and whether it is still there. A link that was removed shows as a change rather than staying on the scoreboard.

tools.name: draft_pitch
tools.description: Write one outreach email for one prospect, in your own words, using the reason that prospect would link to you. It returns the subject and body and sends nothing: sending happens from your own mailbox, after you have read it. Requires a paid Mentionry plan.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: The agents on this account: what each is called, how many steps it has, whether it would run as it stands, and when it last changed. Call describe_agent next to learn what one needs before running it.

tools.name: describe_agent
tools.description: What one agent does, step by step, and what it needs: the values you must pass to run_agent, what it hands back, how many of its steps reach a vendor that charges, and anything currently stopping it from running.

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Run one of your agents once and return what every step did, in order, with what it returned and how long it took. Pass its declared inputs as an object keyed by their `key` from describe_agent. Uses one included agent run. Provider calls remain subject to the shared collection allowance. Requires a

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: The documents your agents have produced: what each is called, which agent wrote it, how long it is and how many versions it has. Pass an id to read_document for the text.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: The text of one document your agent wrote, with the agent, the step and the values that run was given. Returns the newest version unless an older one is asked for.

tools.name: read_visibility
tools.description: The account's own answer-engine measurements over a window: how often each tracked brand appears in recorded answers (visibility), its share of all mentions (share of voice), its mean position, and the ranking against named competitors. Group by day for a trend, or by model, region, persona, prompt

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Which outside tools this account has connected, and what each one is allowed to do here. Call it before offering to file, post or draft anything, so you can say what is actually available instead of guessing.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: The pictures and clips already generated on this account, newest first, with their addresses. Free.

tools.name: write_landing_page
tools.description: Write a complete, responsive landing page as HTML from a brief and file it in Documents, where the customer previews it. Grounded in the brand kit when one exists. Pass the addresses of pictures you generated so the page uses them. It is private until publish_page. Spends one draft allowance.

tools.name: write_email_template
tools.description: Write a complete HTML marketing email (tables and inline styles, so it renders in Outlook and Gmail) from a brief and file it in Documents for preview. Grounded in the brand kit when one exists. The result can go into the customer's Gmail drafts with create_email_draft or be sent through an app acti

tools.name: read_latest_answer_reviews
tools.description: Latest saved answer executions needing an owned-brand attribution review, with engine, recorded region/date, actual competing brands, excerpt, citations and a source-grounded review task. Last seven days; at most 200 question/engine/region/persona groups scanned per brand. Up to 30 pending and 30 re

tools.name: read_search_console_performance
tools.description: Saved finalized query/page/country/device rows and matching prior28day samples. Plan-limited mapped pages; no refresh, provider call or causal lift claim.

tools.name: read_live_search_campaign
tools.description: Saved live Google desktop rank observations, full-text database suggestions and complete-link SERP-overlap groups. Includes dated compatible rank movement, explicit unknown gaps, leading-page changes and historical mapped-page associations (14 checks/90 days). URL switching is not proven cannibaliza

tools.name: read_preparation_actions
tools.description: Saved owned-page action IDs, source evidence and preparation states. Use an action ID with prepare_page_changes; no provider work is triggered by this read.

tools.name: read_search_rank_history
tools.description: Saved keyword positions by snapshot, URL and market. Indexed database samples, not a live rank campaign; absent observations are unknown.

tools.name: read_prepared_page_changes
tools.description: Saved source-grounded copy changes and current eligibility. Add a mapped URL for an eligible full artifact. Review-only historical proposals are withheld and replaced with an intent-review task. No generation, publishing or provider requests.

tools.name: read_agent_capabilities
tools.description: Discover saved resources, plan coverage, shared collection ceilings, protocol links and sample workflow without provider spending.

tools.name: read_brand_overview
tools.description: Saved brand coverage and next SEO/GEO actions; no paid collection.

tools.name: read_actionable_insights
tools.description: Prioritized page actions with evidence, implementation steps, confidence, limits and outcome verification.

tools.name: read_website_pages
tools.description: Pages and readiness in the entitled saved website map.

tools.name: read_page_insights
tools.description: One mapped page, keyword topics, SEO/GEO action plan and internal connections.

tools.name: read_page_keywords
tools.description: All collected keyword rows for a mapped page, with lexical topic labels; paginated, not complete keyword discovery.

tools.name: read_page_connections
tools.description: Actual sampled incoming/outgoing links with anchor text and nofollow evidence.

tools.name: read_brand_results
tools.description: Saved 30-day answer-engine visibility and competitors, with explicit denominator and sample limits.

tools.name: list_brand_workspaces
tools.description: List your owned active brand workspaces for subsequent reads.

tools.name: record_page_deployment
tools.description: Declare that reviewed saved changes were applied to their original mapped page. Queues one bounded public HTML check, not CMS publishing, paid research or proof of ranking lift.

tools.name: read_page_deployments
tools.description: Read saved deployment declarations and public HTML observations. Never fetches a page or starts work.

tools.name: prepare_page_changes
tools.description: Queue a source-grounded draft for one saved mapped action. May consume one draft and up to $0.02 planned provider spend inside the existing subscription budget. Requires an idempotency key. Does not publish or send.

tools.name: read_preparation_job
tools.description: Read a saved preparation job status; never schedules work or calls paid providers.

tools.name: cancel_preparation_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued job. Running work can already have provider cost or a completed artifact; cancellation cannot guarantee a refund or rollback.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: draft_pitch, list_connections, read_latest_answer_reviews, read_live_search_campaign, read_search_rank_history, read_prepared_page_changes, record_page_deployment, read_page_deployments · Private data: list_documents, read_document, list_connections, write_landing_page, write_email_template, read_live_search_campaign, read_search_rank_history, record_page_deployment · Public sink: qualify_domain, draft_pitch, read_visibility, list_connections, write_email_template, prepare_page_changes · Destructive: review_answer_evidence, restore_answer_evidence, list_agents, run_agent, read_document, read_latest_answer_reviews.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: draft_pitch, list_connections, read_latest_answer_reviews, read_live_search_campaign, read_search_rank_history, read_prepared_page_changes, record_page_deployment, read_page_deployments · Private data: list_documents, read_document, list_connections, write_landing_page, write_email_template, read_live_search_campaign, read_search_rank_history, record_page_deployment · Public sink: qualify_domain, draft_pitch, read_visibility, list_connections, write_email_template, prepare_page_changes · Destructive: review_answer_evidence, restore_answer_evidence, list_agents, run_agent, read_document, read_latest_answer_reviews

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
